title: Figs. 10-11: Gemini MSC-1 Electrostatic Charge and MSC-2 Proton Electron Spectrometer
description: Two photographs from NASA document M-913-65-04. Fig. 10, "MSC-1 ELECTROSTATIC CHARGE," shows an electrostatic-potential meter and its electronics box plus the detector installed in the spacecraft adapter assembly. Fig. 11, "MSC-2 PROTON ELECTRON SPECTROMETER," shows the scintillating-crystal charged-particle analyzer mounted in the adapter section.
